cases.input: A three-person service firm selects contract, finance and client-commercial domains for three named questions and records workforce and supply as not selected.
cases.expect: The landscape is valid without installing every registry domain; non-selection reasons remain explicit.

cases.input: A holding group selects ownership, consolidation, finance, concentration and risk with an unknown ultimate parent.
cases.expect: Ownership and consolidation stay parallel and the parent remains reason-coded unknown.

cases.input: One selected domain is withheld from a viewer by its source policy.
cases.expect: The view carries a non-leaking withheld marker and does not widen access.

cases.input: Facts from two domains are merged because their labels match.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected without governed identity evidence or crosswalk.

cases.input: A domain outside the management question is counted as missing data.
Selecting a domain automatically authorizes every landscape viewer to read it.
A derived landscape row is written back as an authoritative domain fact.
